problem_type: Generation waiting effect ownership and terminal cleanup
symptom: Waiting has no img-fx reveal; extending it past success risks leaving media covered.
direct_cause: Old waiting component is removed at running status boundary, with no terminal reveal lifecycle.
class_root: Shared visual boundary must bind image provenance, animation admission and terminal teardown to real task state.
affected_population: Image and video nodes including regeneration, preview frames and terminal success/error

external_sources.purpose: Published props/ref and cycle phase contract

invariants: No real image means empty reveal pool.
At most four visible effects; reduced motion and zoom below 0.4 do not mount effects.
Successful result tears down waiting within 1200ms; failure tears down immediately.
Browser visibility is read after mount; DOM-free audio rendering remains valid.
generality_proof: Both image and video use NodeGeneratingOverlay and GenerationWaitingSurface, independent of model or supplier.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Only a real success transition reveals the actual result; errors remove overlay.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both media kinds share the same overlay call.
Laboratory seeds real node and preview stores, rendering BaseGenerationNode.

recurrence.reason: Every generation and regeneration re-enters this lifecycle.
same_class_scan: rg GenerationWaitingSurface src: production NodeGeneratingOverlay is the sole importer.
Read BaseGenerationNode and ProcessFeedbackStage image/video/preview result producers.
ReactFlowViewport onlyRenderVisibleElements and ReactFlowNodes shouldRenderFullNodeContent already own viewport/full-node admission.

Full suite covers DOM-free audio rendering in generationFeedback.test.ts and laboratory custom event producers in customEventWiring.test.ts; visibility now begins in effect and zoom exposes a real host dispatcher.

prevention.invariant: Only real image sources and bounded terminal lifetime enter admitted visual effects.
prevention.failure_mode: No source leaves empty image pool; completion without an eligible effect removes waiting immediately.
prevention.strategy: Single image/video mapping boundary and module-level admission; replace old CSS sheen.

legacy_paths.rationale: Old CSS sheen and separate preview fade are replaced by library reveal; static reduced-motion surface remains the authorized no-animation case.

dependency_lifecycle.target: A supported img-fx release with configurable reveal duration if 0.5.1 cannot satisfy measured budgets
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Only authorized dependency; official React ref lifecycle retained and bounded by application teardown.
exit_criteria: Upgrade or replace only after user authorization if measured real-node budgets cannot pass, or upstream resource teardown is defective.

migration: No stored data changes; transient effects only.
residual_risks: img-fx 0.5.1 fixes reveal duration internally; the 1.2s application deadline can end a reveal before visible.

invariant_owner_layer.note: Shared transient media waiting layer, not provider or task orchestration.
